description: CDS Schema Extensions for Multitenancy, Caching, and Checkpoints. Foundation layer that extends db/tenant-schema.cds (from main repo) into the worktree with ArtifactCache, LangGraphCheckpoint, LangGraphMessage, IdempotencyRecord entities. Also ports PISystem, DiscoveryJob, Artifact entities and creates new cache-schema.cds and checkpoint-schema.cds files. Updates db/index.cds to use all schemas. No service or UI changes - pure data model.
steps: 1. Create db/tenant-schema.cds in worktree by copying and extending from main repo db/tenant-schema.cds - ensure all existing entities (PISystem, DiscoveryJob, Artifact, AuditLog, etc.) are present

2. Create db/cache-schema.cds with ArtifactCache entity: tenantId String(36), cacheKey String(512), artifactType String(100), payload LargeString, metadata LargeString, ttlSeconds Integer default -1, expiresAt Timestamp, hitCount Integer default 0, lastAccessedAt Timestamp, version Integer default 1, checksum String(64). Add unique index on (tenantId, cacheKey)

3. Create db/checkpoint-schema.cds with: LangGraphCheckpoint entity (tenantId, threadId, checkpointId, parentId, state LargeString, metadata LargeString, createdAt Timestamp) and LangGraphMessage entity (tenantId, threadId, messageId, role String(20), content LargeString, toolCalls LargeString, createdAt Timestamp)

4. Create db/idempotency-schema.cds with IdempotencyRecord entity: tenantId String(36), idempotencyKey String(256), operation String(100), status String(20), result LargeString, expiresAt Timestamp, createdAt Timestamp. Add unique index on (tenantId, idempotencyKey)

5. Create db/index.cds that uses all schema files: using from './aiconx-schema'; using from './brain-schema'; using from './tenant-schema'; using from './cache-schema'; using from './checkpoint-schema'; using from './idempotency-schema';
6. Update package.json cds.requires section to ensure db model points to db/ folder
acceptance_criteria: Running 'npx cds build --production' succeeds without errors
Generated csn.json contains all entities: ArtifactCache, LangGraphCheckpoint, LangGraphMessage, IdempotencyRecord, PISystem, DiscoveryJob, Artifact
All entities have tenantId field for tenant isolation
verification: npx cds compile db/index.cds --to json succeeded with all entities compiled
Verified cache.ArtifactCache, checkpoint.LangGraphCheckpoint, checkpoint.LangGraphMessage, idempotency.IdempotencyRecord entities present in compiled output
Verified tenant.PISystem, tenant.DiscoveryJob, tenant.Artifact, tenant.AuditLog entities present in compiled output
All entities have tenantId String(36) not null field for tenant isolation
findings: CDS compilation succeeded. Note: Step 6 (update package.json cds.requires) was not needed as CAP auto-discovers models from db/ and srv/ folders. All entities compiled successfully with proper tenant isolation via tenantId field.
